title: Canonical market price observation row (INR/kg)
description: One source report of one market/product on one day. Prices are canonical INR/kg; sourceUnit records the unit the source published. min/max are market quotation bounds, never prediction-interval endpoints.

availableAtBasis.description: recorded = observed publication/first-seen time; conservative_upper_bound = latest possible time, used as-is; estimated = unverifiable, rejected from strict replay; assumed_* = availability assigned by a declared, disclosed replay policy (observation date + a stated lag), accepted by strict replay and counted in the feature audit, never a recorded time.
